name: Georgia
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A US state with two AVAs, Upper Hiwassee Highlands and Dahlonega Plateau. Wine is made in all fifty states, and the American industry rests almost entirely on the European Vitis vinifera.
